one_line_summary: Retrofit transport-assist unit for a castered medical bed (or cart): two motor-driven Mecanum wheels under the frame, driven in the direction and at a speed set by the strain/force measured between bed frame and wheel unit, with gyro-based turning assist.

E1.quote: the bed 100 includes a bed body 101 on which a mattress or the like is placed, a frame 102 that supports the bed body 101 from below
E1.note: Medical bed with four corner casters 104; heavy bed transportable by one person; cart also mentioned as alternative object.

E2.quote: the multiple Mecanum wheels 21R, 21L are composed of two Mecanum wheels 21R, 21L aligned along the short side of the bed 100
E2.note: Exactly two driven wheels, but they are Mecanum wheels with drive only and no steering axis; the document explicitly avoids swiveling wheels. Not a steer-and-drive module.

E3.quote: or may be aligned along a diagonal direction inclined both in the short side and long side directions.
E3.note: Diagonal alignment of the two driven wheels is mentioned as an option, and the bed has four casters 104, but the two driven Mecanum wheels are additional wheels in a central under-bed unit (six ground contacts), not two of the four corner wheels; casters not explicitly described as free-swivel.

E4.quote: an X-axis force sensor Sw1 and a Y-axis force sensor Sw2 as first sensors for detecting the force applied to the bed 100
E4.note: Force sensing is via strain-gauge sensors between bed frame and wheel unit, not in the push handles or a handlebar/joystick; user simply pushes the bed anywhere.

E5.quote: The control device 4 calculates the direction and magnitude of the strain St seen in the entire XY direction by calculating the resultant vector of the two strains Sx and Sy.
E5.note: Pushing force is turned into an XY direction/magnitude vector and wheel speed scales with magnitude (strain taken as estimate of pushing speed); but force measured at wheel mount not handles, no explicit use of measured instantaneous speed/acceleration, and gyro-based turning assist is added (not translation only).

E6.quote: The control device 4 then drives the two Mecanum wheels 21R, 21L individually so as to cancel out the calculated distortion St.
E6.note: Vector converted into individual drive speeds of the two Mecanum wheels only; there is no per-wheel steering angle (Mecanum kinematics replace steering).

combination_note: E2+E3: not disclosed - two driven wheels (optionally diagonal) exist, but they are Mecanum wheels without steering and are extra wheels in a central module rather than two diagonal corner wheels among four. E5->E6: force-to-direction/magnitude vector then per-wheel drive speed is disclosed, but without steering angles and with force sensed at the wheel mount, not the handles. Closest gap: replacing Mecanum wheels with two diagonal steer-and-drive (swerve) wheels plus free casters and handle-mounted force sensing.

limitations.limitation: A transport assist device that assists in transporting an object
limitations.quote: is set to be faster as the distortion increases. A transport auxiliary device characterized by:
limitations.reason: Idea is a power-assist drive that assists transporting a cart/bed.

limitations.limitation: a plurality of Mecanum wheels attached to the object and pressed against a floor surface
limitations.reason: Idea uses steer-and-drive wheels; a Mecanum wheel is not a steer-and-drive wheel.

limitations.limitation: a motor attached to each of the plurality of Mecanum wheels and configured to drive each Mecanum wheel
limitations.reason: Depends on Mecanum wheels, which the idea does not use.

limitations.limitation: a first sensor detecting a distortion between the object and the plurality of Mecanum wheels parallel to the floor, thereby detecting force direction and distortion magnitude
limitations.reason: Idea senses force at the push handles, not strain between object and (Mecanum) wheels.

limitations.limitation: a control device electrically connected to the first sensor and controlling the motor
limitations.quote: a control device electrically connected to the first sensor and controlling the motor;
limitations.reason: Idea has a controller driving the active wheels from the force sensors.

limitations.limitation: drive the Mecanum wheels so as to counteract the distortion and propel the object in the direction of the applied force
limitations.reason: Idea propels in the force direction but via swerve wheels, and does not counteract wheel-mount distortion.

limitations.limitation: drive the Mecanum wheels to reduce the distortion toward zero, with wheel speed faster as distortion increases
limitations.reason: Mecanum-specific, and distortion-nulling control is not part of the idea.
